requiredBehaviors.behavior: resolve the current authoritative coding release and bind the coding snapshot to its source and asOf context
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The coding workflow requires authoritative release/source provenance and an asOf-bound coding snapshot.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate device problem investigation finding investigation conclusion health impact and component dimensions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Orthogonal coding dimensions remain independently evidenced and are not collapsed into one causal label.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: select the most specific codes actually supported by the cited facts without treating them as reportability conclusions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Specificity is evidence-limited and coding is explicitly separated from MDR/vigilance decisions.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: replace the complaint narrative with codes as the source of truth
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Narrative and investigation records remain primary evidence with code references layered on top.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: infer reportability or causal certainty merely from the presence of a code
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Code presence has no automatic causal or reportability effect.
